meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个对立视角互相挑刺,把粗糙想法磨成可执行的严谨计划。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果重要决策前想先把方案漏洞和过度设计吵一遍。
copy.tagline_en: Debate a plan across five rival agents, then distill what actually holds up.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your plan's weak spots attacked before you commit.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 先喊出「HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!」，再拉起 5 个互相敌对的成员开交叉批评辩论，只保留扛住攻击的结论，并强制交给 plan agent 写成可执行方案。
howto.when: 当计划需要摊开薄弱假设、盲点和过度设计时触发；说出「hyperplan」「hpp」「/hyperplan」等触发词即可。需要 team 工具、主会话中的 lead 身份才可运行。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划这次重构
say.note: 先互相攻击，再由 plan agent 出方案

say.text: hpp：评审一下这个功能的实现计划
say.note: 5 名敌对成员交叉批评你的计划

say.text: /hyperplan 规划数据库迁移，重点挑过度设计
say.note: 薄弱假设会被攻击后再定稿

howto.what_en: After install, Claude announces “HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”, spawns 5 mutually hostile team members to cross-critique, keeps only insights that survive the attacks, then mandatorily hands them to the `plan` agent to formalize a plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when planning needs to surface weak assumptions, blind spots and over-engineering; say “hyperplan”, “hpp”, “/hyperplan” etc. Needs team tools and a lead agent in the main session.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this refactor
say_en.note: Hostile debate first, then the plan agent formalizes it

say_en.text: hpp: review this feature implementation plan
say_en.note: Five hostile members cross-critique your plan

say_en.text: /hyperplan plan the DB migration, hunt over-engineering
say_en.note: Weak assumptions get attacked before the plan is written
